title: UI polish: art-direction style test and layout mockups (design only)

Interactive mockups in direction B for buy, price, reveal, evening and home: one top bar, slim rival stalls, plain-language demand, one focus per phase
Motion: a short animated example of the reveal flip and button and fruit feedback
All art original; reference games are inspiration only
exclusions: Building the chosen design (a separate plan after the owner picks)
